slots.jd.custom-homes.about:
About us and the job
Pennington Custom Homes is an owner-run builder of custom homes in Asheville, NC. We build every house on site, and the owner is out on the job most days. We are looking for an apprentice carpenter who wants to learn the trade by doing real work alongside experienced carpenters, from the first concrete forms to the last piece of trim.
slots.jd.custom-homes.duties:
What the job involves
- Keep the site safe and tidy, follow safety rules and report hazards right away
- Install doors and windows so they sit level, plumb and sealed
- Cut and install interior and exterior trim with clean, tight joints
- Build and brace forms for concrete footings, walls and slabs
- Carry materials, set up tools and help the crew wherever needed
slots.jd.custom-homes.needs:
What you need
- 1 or more years of experience in carpentry or construction
- Skills in scaffold erection, jobsite safety and blueprint reading
- Experience with finish trim, power tool use and subfloor installation
- A current Construction Safety Card (required)
- An Apprenticeship Completion Certificate (preferred)
slots.r1.b1: Builds concrete forms from work platforms set up through careful scaffold erection, cutting form setup time by 55 percent on recent pours.
slots.r1.b2: Applies jobsite safety practices every day, clearing walkways, checking guardrails and storing tools so the crew works on a clean, safe site.
slots.r1.b3: Frames walls and floors with rough openings sized for door and window installation, reducing rework on openings by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Reads plans and measures rise and run for stair building, then marks stringers for the journeyman to check before cutting.
slots.r1.i1: Joined Tillman Brothers Carpentry as an apprentice carpenter, helping frame walls and floors under a journeyman's direction.
slots.r1.i2: Reads plans and takes measurements at Tillman Brothers Carpentry, turning drawings into layout marks the crew builds from.
slots.summary.1: Apprentice carpenter with about 1 year of experience working under a journeyman who checks each stage of the work. Handles scaffold erection, door and window installation and material takeoffs, and holds a Construction Safety Card.
slots.summary.2: Carpentry apprentice with 1 year on site, doing scaffold erection, door and window installation and material takeoffs under a journeyman's review. Completed an Apprenticeship Certificate in carpentry at Cedar Valley Trades Academy.
